note: CAD assembly animation and simulated operation. Purchased parts are nominal envelopes. Follow the assembly manual for wiring, torque, calibration and physical test gates.

chapters.title: Ten STL designs. Eleven printed parts.
chapters.instruction: Bronze Dalek | Original TTGO T-Display ESP32 | CAD assembly preview

chapters.title: 01 | Reinforced motor base
chapters.instruction: Mate four Adafruit 3777 motors with 3766 wheels; lower the pairs into the one-piece base.
chapters.narration: Seat the four T T motors and wheels in the reinforced, one piece base.

chapters.title: 02 | Retain the motors
chapters.instruction: Eight padded clamp strips and sixteen M3 bolts retain the four motors.
chapters.narration: Add the clamp strips and sixteen retaining bolts.

chapters.title: 03 | Lower skirt first
chapters.instruction: Fasten the lower ring to the base before fitting electronics; seat its locating joint.
chapters.narration: Fit the lower skirt before adding the electronics.

chapters.title: 04 | Electronics and battery
chapters.instruction: Fit two FR4 plates, nylon spacers and boards; secure the disconnected 12 V, 6 Ah battery with two straps.
chapters.narration: Mount the insulating plates, spacers, and boards. Secure the battery with two straps.

chapters.title: 05 | Stack the upper skirt
chapters.instruction: Seat the complete upper skirt and fasten its four M4 joints.
chapters.narration: Seat and fasten the upper skirt.

chapters.title: 06 | Fit the shoulder components
chapters.instruction: Bench fit speaker, rear T-Display, four edge-retaining tabs and both power switches.
chapters.narration: Bench fit the speaker, switches, and original T T G O T Display. Retain its edges.

chapters.title: 07 | Seat the shoulder
chapters.instruction: Connect labelled harness plugs, leave service loops and fasten the shoulder.
chapters.narration: Seat the shoulder. Keep cables clear of each joint.

chapters.title: 08 | Fasten the neck
chapters.instruction: Tighten the neck bolts before fitting the head drive servo.
chapters.narration: Fasten the neck before installing the head drive servo.

chapters.title: 09 | Bearing-supported head
chapters.instruction: Fit two 608 bearings, retainers, inner-race spacer, narrow shims and M8 spindle. Keep the head loose for belt fitting.
chapters.narration: Fit the bearings, spacer, shims, and spindle. Prepare the head.

chapters.title: 10 | Head drive
chapters.instruction: Fit the FS5103R and pulley. Preload the O-ring on the loose head hub, then lower and retain the head.
chapters.narration: Fit the drive and belt. Then seat the head.

chapters.title: 11 | Two-axis arm assemblies
chapters.instruction: Fit two yaw servos, two shared carriers, two pitch servos and both arms; centre horns before attachment.
chapters.narration: Fit both yaw servos, carriers, pitch servos, and arms. Set the neutral positions.

chapters.title: 12 | Local Wi-Fi control
chapters.instruction: Illustrative rear screen: direct access point, then access point plus a 2.4 GHz network.

chapters.title: 13 | Head and arm motion
chapters.instruction: Simulated continuous head rotation and circular arm-tip paths. Original robot sound effects.

chapters.title: 14 | Four-wheel motion
chapters.instruction: Simulated forward travel, broad moving arc, reverse and stop on a level floor.

chapters.title: Assembly complete | Prototype design
chapters.instruction: 543.8 mm tall | Physical fit, strength, driving and stop tests remain required. See the assembly manual.
